name: Town Market
description: The town's primary daily market for fresh vegetables, fruits, and local greens sourced directly from nearby agricultural farms. Early mornings offer the best prices.

name: Weekly Santhe
description: A bustling weekly gathering where regional farmers and traders sell fresh produce, grains, traditional utensils, and household goods. A vibrant cultural experience.

name: Town Flower Market
description: A fragrant market situated right beside the temple entrance. Vendors provide fresh jasmine, vibrant marigolds, and essential pooja items for daily worship.
